description: Dependency updates (ADR 0041). Grouped, weekly, with a cooldown before an update is proposed. Actions and images stay pinned to digests, except the helper images of the Compose stack, which keep the version tags operators set (group Compose-Images).

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one weekly pull request, pinned to full commit SHAs
Python development tools of the repository gates
Node development tools of the repository gates
Release binaries: Renovate bumps the version, a maintainer refreshes the sha256 pins with `make tools-lock` (CI fails until then, on purpose)
prBodyNotes: Refresh the pins before merging: `make tools-lock TOOL=<name> VERSION=<version>` per tool, then review the sha256 diff.

packageRules.description: SDK code generators (docs/DECISIONS.md M2-23/2): the generated cores are regenerated in the same pull request, so `make api-clients` fails until then, on purpose
prBodyNotes: Regenerate before merging: `make -C sdk/python generate` and `make -C sdk/typescript generate`, then update the versions in docs/spec/06-api.md section 14 (tools/docs/tests/test_toolchain_doc.py checks them).

packageRules.description: Hermes Agent version of the recording harness (plugins/hermes-adapter/tests/hermes_pin.toml): the recording test fails until the fixtures are recorded again, on purpose
prBodyNotes: Record again before merging: `make -C plugins/hermes-adapter record` (it also regenerates `tests/hermes_requirements.txt` when the pinned commit has no `uv.lock`), review the fixture diff in `plugins/hermes-adapter/tests/fixtures/recording/`, set `recorded_on`, and update docs/spec/09-agenten.md 17.10 (and every section an adapted point names).

packageRules.description: Trivy stays on the release the vendor advisory GHSA-69fq-xp46-6x23 names as safe; a newer one needs the manual check in docs/quality/toolchain.md

Validators of the Compose images follow the image versions in infra/compose/ (group Compose-Images); the maintainer refreshes them with `make tools-lock` in the image pull request, and the check tool-versions of `make ops-check` fails until then

Images of the helper services in the Compose stack (ADR 0041): the variable in infra/compose/.env.example and its default in infra/compose/compose.yaml change in one pull request. The variables carry the version tags operators read and set, so no digest pinning here
prBodyNotes: Refresh the validators of these images before merging: `make tools-lock TOOL=<name> VERSION=<version>` for otelcol-contrib (otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib), promtool (prom/prometheus), amtool (prom/alertmanager), loki (grafana/loki) and tempo (grafana/tempo), then `make ops-check`.

packageRules.description: SeaweedFS image of the S3 driver tests (docs/DECISIONS.md M3-02/13): its version equals BOTHY_SEAWEEDFS_VERSION, so it joins the group Compose-Images and moves in the same pull request; TestSeaweedImagePinned fails when the three differ

PostgreSQL test image: the pgtest containers and the overlay of the Compose smoke test pin the same postgres:18 digest and move in one pull request; test_overlay_postgres_pin_equals_pgtest fails when they differ
Major updates wait for approval on the dependency dashboard

SeaweedFS image of the S3 driver tests, pinned by digest; the version follows BOTHY_SEAWEEDFS_VERSION
PostgreSQL image of the pgtest containers, pinned by digest like tools/sonarqube/compose.yaml
Registry image of the trial release (tools/ci/release_trial.py), pinned by digest
